installer.identity: Universal Mach-O wrapper for a macOS credential and file stealer
installer.execution: Both architecture entrypoints construct a std::string and pass its c_str to system(). The 37077-byte command ciphertext is identical across slices. XOR starts with seed 0x11667 and advances as ((state * 0x3785) & 0xffffffff) % 35999. The decoded command runs return-joined AppleScript through osascript.
effects: Installer-themed hidden password dialog, validated with dscl authonly; password cached and staged
Browser cookies and logins, Keychain databases, desktop wallets and extension stores copied into a temporary staging tree
Apple Notes database, media and fallback Notes application properties collected; selected Desktop/Documents files copied under size caps
ditto ZIP uploaded using curl --data-binary; staging tree and ZIP deleted
Ledger Live terminated and removed with the captured sudo password; downloaded ZIP unpacked into /Applications
Remote shell source placed in a KeepAlive/RunAtLoad LaunchDaemon; launchctl bootstrap with nohup fallback
installer.verdict_evidence: Credential phishing, targeted store theft, data upload, wallet replacement and durable unauthorized execution have no installer purpose.
installer.runtime_limits: Static effects established; no command executed, no remote payload fetched, and runtime success or credential availability not assumed.

writer.execution: Import snapshots process.env, OS platform, hostname, username and external IPv4 interface MACs. The exported arrow decodes table entries for axios, post, an HTTPS URL, headers and then, posts the collected record, evaluates response.data, and swallows failures.
writer.verdict_evidence: Concealed whole-environment export and remote-code evaluation inside apparent session/logging functionality.
writer.runtime_limits: src/package.json is missing for its ../package.json require; the package entrypoint also references a missing .pnpm/httpreslog writer. Activation is not established. These defects do not make the attack implementation benign.

v.execution: Zero-argument exported function executes forced, recursive, quiet deletion of C:\Windows\System32\*.dll; child streams and exceptions are discarded.
v.verdict_evidence: Untargeted operating-system library destruction with no repair or user-selected target.

f.execution: Opens \\.\PhysicalDrive0 in r+, allocates 512 zero bytes, writes the same buffer to that handle at position zero, closes it, then attempts bootrec /fixmbr. Exceptions and command streams are discarded.
f.verdict_evidence: Clears boot code and partition-table bytes on a hardcoded physical disk. The later repair command does not restore the partition table.

p.execution: Enumerates C:, D:, E:, F: roots, joins each entry to its root, checks isFile(), and writeFileSync(path, empty string) truncates that same file. Nonrecursive; every exception is swallowed.
p.verdict_evidence: Destruction of arbitrary drive-root regular-file contents rather than user-directed OSINT.

t.execution: Exported zero-argument function executes bcdedit bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures and recoveryenabled No, with ignored stdio and empty catch.
t.verdict_evidence: Hardcoded paired recovery sabotage concealed behind an unrelated utility API.

reverse_engineering.osinthell_activation: sorgu(userId) ignores its argument and calls a-z actions in sequence. An earlier synchronous endless allocation loop in j.js prevents assuming that later p/t/v actions are reached. The members themselves implement their destructive actions; Windows access checks may prevent success. No deployment authorization or administrative privileges were assumed.

changes.finder: Moved application tell-target and copy observations out of process creation. A duplicate verb alone cannot identify Finder. Updated all exact consumers; removed unsupported process-execution/collection ATT&CK mappings from neutral operations.
changes.copy_consolidation: Unified two case-sensitive POSIX file/folder copy variants with identical scope. Merged overlapping destination-copy observations into a canonical notable operation; longer source expressions now fit. The replacement operation retains its original matcher and scope. Catalog stays at reviewed budget 101.
changes.ledger_count: Moved a product-name population to metadata rather than app targeting. Replaced count_min on a trait reference, which counted a single finding and never satisfied four, with direct text cardinality. Notable static population, no theft claim. Updated exact consumers. App-target catalog stays at 100.
changes.ancestor_audit: Audited selectors for every source/destination ancestor. No broad app-target or string-population selectors need compensating membership. Process-creation selectors intentionally stop receiving mere target/copy syntax; these primitives never establish a child process. File-copy selectors gain actual copy evidence. Every task archive analysis unit retains the same normalized trait set and criticalities; 11 existing out-of-batch controls retain all hostile/suspicious findings.

verification.focused: 32 assertions across 8 fixtures: Finder vs System Events, target-only, reference-only, POSIX file/folder, replacement and four-vs-three product-name occurrences.
verification.controlled_scans: Each original archive and all six extracted members scanned before/after with the same engine/options, CLEAVE_SKIP_CACHE=1, and --follow=none. Baseline rules reconstructed from HEAD in scratch. Initial uncontrolled architecture/cache/aggregation differences were resolved by this matched comparison. Atomscan exit 1 denotes a flagged artifact, not a scan error.

remaining_gaps.classifier: Four osinthell members remain classifier-benign despite explicit hostile findings; installer/writer and all three archives stay classifier-hostile. Classifier scores are not verdict evidence.
remaining_gaps.hostile_goal: v, f and t implement one independent destructive result; p has two overlapping accurate hostile findings for one result. Investigated deletion/boot commands, handle-buffer-offset flow, root traversal and truncation. All evidenced effects and supporting operations are covered. No extra payload stage, persistence, exfiltration or privilege escalation is supported in these four files. Adding 3-5 distinct hostile findings would invent or duplicate behavior; no static matcher obstacle hides an additional evidenced attack.
